description: RIFTEN GLOBAL SURPLUS: The Rift is lush and full of mead. Ingredients and Alcohol are generally cheap.
RIFTEN GLOBAL DEFICIT: The Rift has no mines. Metal ingots and heavy gear are expensive imports.
BLACK-BRIAR MONOPOLY: The city is drowning in mead. It is cheaper than water here, and selling it is pointless.
LAKE BOUNTY: Lake Honrich is teeming with fish. Fishermen sell them for pennies.
THIEVES MARKET: 'Fenced' goods flood the market. Light armor and tools of the trade are easy to find cheap.
HEAVY METAL DEFICIT: Balimund is the only smith and has to import every ingot. He pays a premium for Iron/Steel.
EXOTIC IMPORTS: High demand for Skooma and Moon Sugar despite the vice culture. These are imported from Elsweyr/Morrowind.
